hero.title: Your Real-Time AI Crop Doctor in Your Pocket
hero.subtitle: Photograph any sick leaf or affected plant to get an instant disease diagnosis, severity assessment, and practical organic and chemical treatment advice in your native language.

steps.title: How CropDoctor Works
steps.subtitle: Simple 3-step healing process designed for every farmer, even with low bandwidth.
steps.step1Desc: Take a clear, focused photo of the diseased leaf or plant using your phone camera or gallery.
steps.step2Desc: Our AI analyzes leaf spots, coloration, and lesions to identify the exact pathogen in seconds.
steps.step3Desc: Receive step-by-step organic remedies, safe chemical treatments, and preventive measures.

scan.title: Crop Health Scanner
scan.subtitle: Upload or snap a photo of the affected crop leaf for instant diagnosis.
scan.dragDrop: Drag and drop leaf photo here, or tap to select
scan.cameraActive: Camera Active - Point at affected leaf
scan.step2: Evaluating symptom patterns with neural model...
scan.errorNoFile: Please select or capture a crop leaf image first.
scan.errorInvalidFormat: Please upload a valid image file (JPG, PNG, WEBP).

result.title: Diagnostic Report
result.healthyDesc: No significant disease symptoms detected. Keep up balanced fertilization and regular scouting.
result.lowConfidenceAlert: Low Confidence Notice: The image patterns are ambiguous. We strongly recommend cross-verifying with your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agricultural extension officer before applying intensive chemical treatments.
result.feedbackThanks: Thank you for your feedback! It helps improve diagnosis accuracy.

settings.title: Settings & Account
settings.subtitle: Manage theme appearance, profile details, data exports, and account security.
settings.dataExportDesc: Download a full copy of your farm scan history and account profile in standard JSON format.
settings.deleteAccountDesc: Permanently erase your account, login credentials, and all recorded crop scans. This action is irreversible.
settings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account? All scan records will be permanently destroyed.

history.title: Your Crop Scan History
history.subtitle: Track diagnosed diseases, treatments applied, and recovery progress across your fields.
history.empty: No scans recorded yet. Capture your first crop leaf to start tracking.

advisory.title: Weather & Pest Outbreak Radar
advisory.subtitle: Real-time humidity, precipitation, and temperature tracking to forecast fungal and bacterial blight risks.
advisory.riskHigh: High Fungal Risk: High humidity (>80%) and temperatures favor Early/Late Blight spores.
advisory.riskModerate: Moderate Risk: Monitor low-canopy leaves for fungal powdery spots.
advisory.riskLow: Low Risk: Weather conditions currently favorable for healthy crop growth.
advisory.kvkSubtitle: Need human expert confirmation? Reach out to your nearest government agricultural center.

auth.title: Farmer Sign In / Registration
auth.subtitle: Sign in with your mobile phone or email to save your farm scan history and customized advisory.
auth.demoInfo: No login credentials required. Test all scanning, diagnosis, and localization features instantly in sandbox mode.

cookie.title: Cookie & Data Consent Preferences
cookie.text: CropDoctor uses essential cookies to remember your language selection and scan session. In compliance with the India DPDP Act 2023, we give you granular control over cookies.

legal.disclaimer: AI Diagnosis Disclaimer: CropDoctor is an AI-driven advisory tool. Crop remedies are recommendations and should be balanced with local agronomist guidance. CropDoctor is not liable for crop yield variations.
legal.grievanceDesc: For data access, correction, erasure requests, or grievances under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, email: grievance@cropdoctor.app (Response within 72 hours).
